SELECT coalesce( temp_dish.name, temp_setmeal.name ) AS name, sum( number ) AS sales_count FROM (
SELECT dish_id, setmeal_id, number FROM order_detail WHERE order_id IN (
SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = #{status} AND #{begin} <= order_time AND order_time < #{endExclusive} ) ) AS temp_detail
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, name FROM dish ) AS temp_dish ON temp_detail.dish_id = temp_dish.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, name FROM setmeal ) AS temp_setmeal ON temp_detail.setmeal_id = temp_setmeal.id
GROUP BY coalesce( temp_dish.name, temp_setmeal.name ) ORDER BY sales_count DESC, name ASC LIMIT #{limit}
